purpose: Marketplace onboarding. A merchant submits their business profile, the platform creates the connected account, then shows the merchant a confirmation screen: this is the name your buyers will see on their card statement. Support quotes the same string back when a buyer calls about a charge they do not recognize.

reads.note: written to the merchant row at onboarding and treated as settled from then on; support reads it from there rather than from Stripe, so a change at the source is never noticed
the positive control. Non-null and identical on both versions, so an absence of difference on the descriptor cannot be a business profile that silently failed to apply
the confirmation screen's headline: 'charges will appear as X'. The merchant approves onboarding against this string
shown beneath the descriptor as the prefix applied to per-charge suffixes. Null on 2022-11-15, so the screen renders the row empty and the merchant is told there is no prefix
gates whether onboarding finishes or routes the merchant to Stripe's hosted requirements flow
re-read on the confirmation screen; the control again, on the step the merchant actually sees
the same onboarding path for a merchant who supplies no business name. Both versions derive from the url and still disagree: WWW. survives on 2022-11-15 and is stripped on basil
